---
title: "Guides"
subtitle: "Worked front matter, one page per topic."
description: "How to select a preset, write each document type, and use the three formats of the mcanouil extension, with one page for each topic."
---

An option goes in one of three places:

- A Quarto format option goes under `format: mcanouil-html:`, `mcanouil-typst:` or `mcanouil-revealjs:`.
- An option of the extension goes under `extensions: mcanouil:`.
- An attribute or a class goes on the element.

| [Special sections](examples/special-sections.qmd) | References, appendices and supplementary sections in Typst. |
| [Memo](examples/memo.qmd) | The four memo kinds and their banner fields. |
| [Letter and invoice](examples/letter-invoice.qmd) | The fields, the two standards and the languages. |
| [Workshop](examples/workshop.qmd) | Session metadata, workshop blocks and solutions. |
| [HTML format](examples/html-format.qmd) | Title block, contents, footer, components and accessibility. |
